# Public Test Fixture Provenance

The public test fixtures are limited to sources with recorded redistribution grounds.

| Group | Source | Public status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `testdata/e2e/` | Deterministically generated by `scripts/creator_repeatability.py` without external image assets | Project synthetic |
| `testdata/tamper/` | Derived from the project synthetic E2E fixture by project test scripts | Project synthetic derivative |
| `testdata/jpeg_realworld/` | Derived from MIT-licensed `recurser/exif-orientation-examples`; the source notice is retained in `testdata/jpeg_realworld_LICENSE_SOURCE.md` | Licensed third-party, notice required |
| `tests/fixtures/inspection/` | Generated from `testdata/e2e/clean_fixture.png` by `scripts/generate_inspection_gui_smoke_fixtures.py` | Project synthetic derivative |

`tests/fixtures/inspection/manifest.json` records the source hash, generator, output hashes, and measured inspection states. Personal images and local interoperability inputs must not be added to these public fixture directories.
